name: zendesk
description: Manage Zendesk tickets, users, organizations, business rules, and Help Center content from Claude.
long_description: A full-spectrum Zendesk integration: Support/Tickets, Users & Organizations, Business Rules (views, macros, triggers, automations, SLAs), Help Center/Guide, and analytics over ticket metrics and incremental exports. Read/write, with no destructive operations. Inbound Zendesk content is screened for prompt injection. Authorize in-app with the zendesk_login tool.

oauth_client_id.title: OAuth Client ID
oauth_client_id.description: Client ID from the OAuth client registered in Zendesk Admin Center

oauth_client_secret.title: OAuth Client Secret
oauth_client_secret.description: Client secret from the OAuth client registered in Zendesk Admin Center

oauth_callback_port.title: OAuth Callback Port
oauth_callback_port.description: Localhost port for the OAuth redirect callback during authorization. The redirect URI you register in Zendesk must use this port.

security_level.title: Injection-Screening Level
security_level.description: strict | standard | off — how aggressively inbound Zendesk content is screened for prompt injection.

markdown_conversion.title: Markdown to HTML Conversion
markdown_conversion.description: Default for converting comment/ticket bodies from Markdown to HTML. A per-call 'markdown' argument overrides this.

timezone.title: Business-Hours Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for business-hours FRT/resolution metrics, e.g. 'Europe/Berlin'. Defaults to UTC.

work_hours.title: Business Work Hours
work_hours.description: Working window as JSON {"start":"HH:MM","end":"HH:MM"}, e.g. {"start":"09:00","end":"17:00"}. Defaults to 09:00-17:00.

workdays.title: Business Workdays
workdays.description: Working days as a JSON array of ISO weekdays (1=Mon ... 7=Sun), e.g. [1,2,3,4,5]. Defaults to Mon-Fri.
